reviews.title: Good Desk Once Working, But Louder, Thinner, and Harder to Set Up Than Advertised
reviews.body: Now that this desk is finally working, I like it. It looks good, feels stable, and it is holding my full setup without any issues. Performance-wise, it does exactly what a sit-stand desk should.However, the assembly process was far more difficult than advertised, and there is a serious setup issue that multiple other reviewers have also experienced.During the very first calibration, my desk went up normally, but once it reached the top, it began to rattle and would never attempt to go back down. The UP button became useless, the desk stayed fully extended, and the motors just chattered at the top. At that point, the desk was completely unusable. After reading reviews, I found several people describing the exact same failure. Many of them were sent replacement controllers.In my case, the controller was not the problem.The real issue was motor placement. I had to:Flip the desk overRemove the two middle support barsReposition them so the motor was attached to the Z-labeled leg onlyReassemble the entire frameThen restart calibrationOnce the motor was correctly mounted on the Z leg, the desk immediately worked normally and completed calibration without any issues. This step is absolutely critical, and it is not clearly explained in the instructions. The instructions make it seem like the motor can go on either leg. It cannot. I had a 50/50 and I lost. If the motor is not on the Z leg, the desk will go up, rattle at the top, and never come back down.The instructions need to be much clearer about this requirement.Additional honest notes for buyers:The motor is louder than advertisedThis is not a 30-minute solo build, especially if anything goes wrongThe desktop is thinner than it appears in the photosEven with all of that, once fixed, the desk itself performs well, which is why I am giving it three stars. But the factory quality control and the clarity of the assembly instructions absolutely need improvement. I am leaving this detailed explanation so future buyers who hit the same “rES" stuck at the top problem have a solution.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 7, 2025

reviews.title: great customer service, great product
reviews.body: I purchased this as a gift for a birthday, it came missing the power cord.  I contacted customer support and they took a couple days to get back with me so i went ahead and purchased a replacement cord.  Upon customer support reaching back out to me I supplied them with the invoice of the new cord I purchased and they refunded my money for the cord.  I was honestly surprised, and very pleased with the service.  The desk was as expected, it works great, I do recommend this product based on my experience with customer service, and the quality of product for the price.
